rca_of_the_issue: RCA: /api/badge/{guest_id} returned 500 for guests registered via API without a 'title' (and potentially company) field. Root cause: previous agent's XSS fix used html.escape(guest.get('title', '')) but MongoDB stored None (not missing) for those fields because the Pydantic GuestRegister model sets title/company as Optional[str]=None and the insert writes the None. dict.get('key', default) only returns default when the key is absent — a None value is returned as-is, and html.escape(None) raises AttributeError. Reproduction: POST /api/register/guest with no 'title' field, then GET /api/badge/{id} → 500. Mitigation applied: replaced guest.get(k, '') with guest.get(k) or '' for name, company, title. Verified by running test_badge_generation (passes) and test_badge_xss_escape (passes).
